label: Prepare for an anticipated death
definition: Put in place will, lasting power of attorney, funeral plan and account access before death. Excludes medical care decisions.
end_state: Will, LPA and funeral wishes documented and accessible to next of kin
notes: Only triggered by anticipated variants. LPA registration with OPG is the partial trace. This is the pre-event signal.

label: Register the death
definition: Obtain death certificate from the registrar. Excludes coroner processes.
notes: Statutory within 5 days in England and Wales.

label: Arrange and pay for the funeral
definition: Choose provider, arrange ceremony, settle cost. Excludes headstone and memorial.
notes: Partial trace only via DWP Funeral Expenses Payment claims.

label: Notify state bodies of the death
definition: Inform DWP, HMRC, DVLA, Passport Office, council. Excludes probate.
end_state: All state records updated and overpayments reconciled
notes: Tell Us Once covers most in one step; uptake is the behaviour of interest.

label: Close or transfer household accounts
definition: Energy, water, telecoms, broadband, subscriptions, insurance in the deceased's name. Excludes bank accounts.
end_state: Every account closed or in the survivor's name with no outstanding balance
notes: No public trace. Supplier bereavement teams see this first. Key touchpoint for the Octopus lens.

label: Administer the estate
definition: Obtain grant of probate or letters of administration, value estate, pay IHT, distribute. Excludes paying individual creditors.
notes: Grant of probate is public via HMCTS probate records.

label: Identify and settle debts of the estate
definition: Notify banks and creditors, freeze accounts, pay liabilities from the estate. Excludes the survivor's own debts.
end_state: All creditors notified and liabilities settled or written off
notes: Partial via credit reference agencies and the Deceased Notification Service.

label: Claim entitlements arising from the death
definition: Bereavement Support Payment, private pension death benefits, life insurance, death-in-service. Excludes inheritance.
notes: BSP has a 3-month window for full amount. Untraced pensions are the classic unfinished need.

label: Secure and maintain the deceased's empty property
definition: Insurance for unoccupied property, council tax exemption, utilities, upkeep. Excludes sale.
notes: Council tax Class F exemption is the partial trace.

label: Sell or transfer the deceased's property
definition: Probate sale, assent to beneficiary, or transfer of joint tenancy. Excludes rental.
start_trigger: Grant of probate (or death if joint tenancy)
notes: Land Registry PPD and title transfers. Probate sales are identifiable in some datasets.

label: Deal with the deceased's vehicles
definition: Notify DVLA, transfer or sell owned vehicle, return or transfer leased vehicle, cancel insurance. Excludes driving licence.
end_state: Every vehicle transferred, sold or returned
notes: DVLA keeper change is the partial trace. Leased EVs are the Octopus EV touchpoint.

label: Manage absence from own employment
definition: Compassionate leave, phased return, informing employer. Excludes the deceased's employment.
notes: Panel data only. Long absences shade into a condition.

label: Receive an inheritance
definition: Assets or cash passed to the bereaved as beneficiary. Excludes administering the estate.
end_state: Assets transferred into beneficiary's name or account
notes: HMRC IHT returns give aggregate visibility. This need carries the link to first_property_purchase.family_assisted.
